title: Appending more than 100 blocks or nesting three levels deep in one Notion request fails with validation_error
symptoms: body failed validation: body.children.length should be ≤ `100`
400 validation_error when a nested list three levels deep is created in one call
Long Markdown imports fail while short ones succeed
cause: Append block children and page creation accept at most 100 blocks per array and only two levels of nesting in a single request. The whole payload is also capped at 1000 block elements and 500KB.
fix: Send top-level blocks in batches of 100 and append deeper children in follow-up calls using the block IDs the first call returns.
affected: Notion REST API, all versions, as of 2026-10
